# Map

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A note used to think, plan, organize, and/or navigate a group of related notes.

**Also known as:** MOC, Map of Content

## Scope note

- It might begin as an index or hub note for a collection of other related notes.
- This typically evolves into a more structured map by collecting links into related groups, adding headings to establish more organization, and additional commentary to provide more context and information.
- Connected with other maps in a network to provide organization and navigation for the linked notes in a PKM system.

## Editorial note

_An open question about this term, not part of its definition._

Should the parent of this concept be a Home Note rather than Obsidian Notes? A Home Note would be a kind of Map — a Map of all the maps, an atlas of the knowledge system — and the single entry point to a vault, carrying the major organizational structure and the navigation paths across every concept in it. If it is added, every Map gains an upward path to it and it becomes the broader concept here in place of Obsidian Notes. It is not in the vocabulary yet, and whether it should be is open.
